svg.title: One recipe, twelve monster attacks
svg.desc: Twelve monster attacks share one animation, each a row of settings: a slash that sweeps across the target or a column of light that rises on it, one to three hits, extras chosen from smoke, drain, glints, sparks and a heavy blow, and one of six colourings. Twin Beaks is a slash in lightning colours that hits twice and throws sparks. Acid Bite is a pink column that hits three times and raises smoke.
svg.text: Each attack is a row of settings: a slash or a
column of light, how many hits, which extras,
